title: Avoid raw multiline code inside orchestration strings
failure_signature: The first scope-aware stale-label recovery wrapper embedded an unescaped multiline Python string in orchestration source and failed before the shell command ran.
trigger_preconditions: A read-only recovery check requires multiline embedded source.
candidate_workaround: Use native PowerShell file selection with explicit historical-domain exclusions and exact Select-String patterns.
recurrence_guard: Do not place raw multiline source inside a quoted orchestration string; use a checked script or native pipeline.
rollback: Retain the orchestration failure, award no scan credit, and rerun only with a parse-safe method.
scope_boundary: Read-only workflow recovery; no file or Git state changed in the failed attempt.
